scenes.title: The Forest That Listens
scenes.narrativeBeat: Sauti enters Naimisha forest; sages ask for the tale. Storytelling frame established.
scenes.purpose: Frame + entry portal; teach zoom-forward interaction

scenes.title: The Sacrifice of Snakes
scenes.narrativeBeat: Janamejaya's sarpasatra; Astika arrives to stop the vengeance ritual.
scenes.purpose: Curse/vengeance thesis; consequence of inherited anger
scenes.visualAnchor: serpent motifs rising in fire smoke

scenes.title: The River Gives and Takes
scenes.narrativeBeat: Shantanu weds Ganga; seven sons returned to the river; eighth kept: Devavrata.
scenes.purpose: Ancestry + water portal grammar; loss as price of desire
scenes.visualAnchor: river reflecting palace, child in reeds

scenes.title: The Vow That Bent the World
scenes.narrativeBeat: Devavrata renounces throne and progeny for Satyavati; becomes Bhishma; celibate guardian.
scenes.purpose: Central curse-mechanism: noble vow with destructive longevity
scenes.visualAnchor: empty throne, raised sword-oath, celibate white

scenes.title: The Poet Born of the River
scenes.narrativeBeat: Satyavati's past (Vyasa); niyoga births Dhritarashtra, Pandu, Vidura; succession knot tied.
scenes.visualAnchor: three cradles, one covered (blindness), sage silhouette

scenes.title: A Hundred and Five Plus One
scenes.narrativeBeat: 100 Kauravas + Dushala; 5 Pandavas (divine births); Karna abandoned on the river.
scenes.purpose: Rival generations established; Karna wound planted
scenes.visualAnchor: river basket with infant Karna drifting past palace lamps

scenes.title: The School of Arrows
scenes.narrativeBeat: Drona trains princes; Arjuna excels; Ekalavya's thumb-gift; rivalry hardens.
scenes.visualAnchor: arrow splitting arrow; severed-thumb offering bowl

scenes.title: The House That Burns
scenes.narrativeBeat: Lacquer house plot; Vidura's warning; escape through tunnel; presumed dead.
scenes.visualAnchor: ornate flammable palace, hidden tunnel mouth

scenes.title: Hunger in the Forest
scenes.narrativeBeat: Hidimba encounter; Bhima slays Hidimba; Bhima-Hidimbi union; Ghatotkacha born.
scenes.purpose: Forest law vs palace law; Bhima's vow-keeper turn
scenes.visualAnchor: giant eyes in dark trees, mace vs claw

scenes.title: The Bow That Chose
scenes.narrativeBeat: Draupadi swayamvara: Arjuna (as Brahmin) bends the bow; rivalry with Karna refused; Draupadi weds five brothers.
scenes.purpose: Draupadi enters as moral fire; insult-to-Karna wound deepens
scenes.visualAnchor: fish-eye target reflected below; five-knotted garland

scenes.title: The Kingdom Splits
scenes.narrativeBeat: Return to Hastinapura; partition; Pandavas receive Khandavaprastha wasteland.
scenes.visualAnchor: map torn along river; half-crown motif

scenes.title: A City from Ashes
scenes.narrativeBeat: Khandava clearing with Krishna-Arjuna; Indraprastha rises; chapter closes, loop-seed back to forest fire.
scenes.purpose: Renewal that is also arson; closes loop to adi-01 fire
scenes.visualAnchor: burning forest blooming into white palace; dog at gate (loyalty seed)
